components.name: Finite precision-genesis, history-collision, hierarchy-geometry, and falsification layer
components.project_addition: Combines canonical Enterprise Math integer-scale, correspondence, collision, future-safe quotient, intrinsic-geometry, and falsification surfaces into a finite precision-genesis research layer. WIP results prove monotonicity of the full binomial history-collision spectrum and merge excess under serial state-extensional relational branching, decompose every spectrum increase into nonnegative branch-copy and cross-source collision terms, and give exact branching/occupied/merge accounting. Negative boundaries show that deterministic towers, finite rational stochastic branching, and finite adaptive interventions over finite rational classical kernels admit finite latent/pre-sampled completions, so online ontic generation requires an additional independently justified structural restriction. Nested refinement signatures induce a divisibility-weighted integer ultrametric but do not by themselves force connected/local Euclidean-like geometry; task-relative future signatures induce an effective precision horizon without establishing a hard physical cutoff. The P016 environment-record premodel supplies a falsifiable visibility inequality while remaining hypothesis-level. The underlying combinatorics, finite probability and functional representation, intervention/structural-causal semantics, hierarchy/ultrametric geometry, quantum cosmology, decoherence, and interferometry literature are established prior art; historical novelty of the synthesis and exact cross-surface collision-spectrum formulation remains unverified.
